title: Skin cyst removal
what: A skin cyst is a small sac under the skin filled with thick material. The surgeon removes it together with its wall, using local numbing.
why: When the cyst grows, gets in the way, becomes inflamed, or is visible on the face or neck.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; stitches usually come out after 7 to 10 days
tell_doctor: If the cyst is inflamed, painful, or has pus right now
Blood thinners. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will decide
Allergy to numbing medicines or antiseptics
A tendency to form keloid scars

prepare.title: Do not touch
prepare.text: Do not squeeze the cyst yourself. It can become inflamed.

prepare.title: Hair
prepare.text: If the cyst is on your head, wash your hair the day before.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no special prep. You can eat.

bring: Ultrasound results, if you had one
steps: The skin is cleaned with antiseptic
A small cut is made, and the cyst is removed with its wall
Stitches and a bandage are put on
The removed tissue is sometimes sent for testing
feel: The numbing injection stings for a few seconds
During removal: pressure and pulling, but no pain
Afterward, the spot aches for 1 to 2 days
after: Keep the bandage dry, as the surgeon says
Come for dressing changes and stitch removal on the set days
Tissue test results usually come in 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling, or pus from the wound
Blood soaks through the bandage and does not stop

faq.a: If the whole wall was removed, usually not. That is why it is removed when there is no strong inflammation.

faq.q: Why is it not removed right away if inflamed?
faq.a: With inflammation, the inflammation is treated first, or the abscess is drained. The cyst itself is removed later.

reminders.text: Skin cyst removal tomorrow. Do not squeeze it. Bring your ID and ultrasound, if you have one.
